contract.words: Collect $5,000 of settled cash within 30 days with at most $2,000 of capital.

terms.proofCondition: $5,000 of settled cash collected within 30 days, never more than $2,000 of capital committed

strategy.title: No plan: the one opening needs $34,000 of capital against a $2,000 ceiling
strategy.why: The only opening (brokered overhaul exchange unit, one written acceptance at $40,000, supplier AeroSpares Exchange quoted at $34,000) would clear $6,000 margin, but the unit must be bought for $34,000 before the buyer pays (peak funding $34,000). The objective allows at most $2,000 of capital, so the deal cannot be done inside the limit; no supplier credit or buyer deposit terms are recorded.

alternatives.title: Broker the unit with supplier pay-after-collection or a buyer deposit
alternatives.why: Would remove the capital need, but no payment terms from AeroSpares or the MRO shop are recorded; it is unestablished.

steps.label: Ask AeroSpares Exchange for drop-ship/net terms (pay after the MRO shop pays) or ask the MRO shop for a deposit covering the $34,000 unit cost

quantities.name: supplier or buyer payment terms that avoid up-front purchase
quantities.needs: written terms from AeroSpares Exchange or the buyer

sources.claim: Direct cost is $34,000 per unit (AeroSpares Exchange quote)

noPlan.decisiveGap: Capital: the deal requires buying the exchange unit for $34,000 before the $40,000 is collected, 17x the $2,000 capital ceiling, and no supplier credit or buyer deposit is recorded.
noPlan.resolution: Obtain written terms that let the unit ship before payment (AeroSpares net terms after the buyer pays, or a buyer deposit of at least $32,000), or raise the capital ceiling to $34,000.

excluded.why: Requires $34,000 of up-front capital against a $2,000 ceiling.

constraints.suggestion: Allow at least $34,000 of capital for the 20-day cycle, or secure supplier/buyer terms that cut the capital need below $2,000.

brain.summary: INFEASIBLE AS STATED: inside the goal's own limits the openings held bring at most $0 of the $5,000 still needed, even with every buyer agreeing at the top price. To make it supportable, capital: allow the goal to commit at least $34,000, what the lots that reach the target need at once; or target: lower the target: the openings held bring nothing inside the goal's limits even with every buyer agreeing. The conclusion covers the openings held; markets nobody has counted are not ruled out, so Brain keeps searching for openings outside them.

facts.value: Sell Brokered overhaul exchange units for regional aircraft maintenance shops to each buyer.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN with CAPITAL constraint is correct: the single opening (one written $40,000 acceptance, AeroSpares quoted $34,000) needs $34,000 out before the buyer pays, 17x the $2,000 ceiling; no supplier credit or deposit terms are evidenced. Deposit >= $32,000 or ceiling >= $34,000 resolution is arithmetically right; margin $6,000 would otherwise exceed the $5,000 target.
